name: The Last Ember Knight
description:
Elian learns of a warrior whose loyalty survived the death of every cause he served.

Use Cataclysm's Flame Eye to locate the Burning Arena. Consult JEI and the mod's mechanics for the summoning offering before confronting Ignis. Defeat the named boss once; tracked earlier kills may count.

Legacy commendation: a victory or advancement earned on another story path can satisfy this record. This does not create a separate instance of the encounter.
